messages:
maria-cs: Heads-up: 8 onboarding customers reported poorer embedding relevance and intermittent 502s during large batch imports after this morning's runtime update. Some of these are in trial/renewal windows. tagging eng + sre for triage and comms.

jon-eng: on it. early indicators show the new quantized model's decode path spikes memory under sustained large-batch ingest; causing timeouts and 502s on the worker. repro on staging with 10k-item batch.

taylor-sre: opened INC-2026-007; setting priority to medium-high given renewal sensitivity. immediate mitigation: apply soft-throttle to ingest workers + divert new high-volume jobs to standby pools. rolling the throttle now.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-007 | priority: medium-high | status: investigating | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-007

maria-cs: thanks. CS needs a short, customer-friendly blurb: impact, what we're doing now, ETA for full resolution, data safety statement, and any goodwill. keep it one paragraph per customer email.

jon-eng: tech draft for CS: "Root cause: memory growth in quantized model artifact during large-batch decoding. Mitigation: throttling ingest batch sizes and diverting jobs; building a fixed artifact. ETA: validated artifact and broad rollout expected within 48-72 hours; we will update sooner if we rollback. Rollback remains an option if validation stalls."

kevin-legal: prefer explicit language: say "we do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration". avoid promising specific hours under 24h; 48-72 window is fine. also, ensure outbound messages are stored per retention policy.

olivia-cs: draft customer email (targeted to 8 impacted contacts) below. planning to post a concise portal status line too. Requesting signoff from SRE/Eng before send.

olivia-cs: ```Hi <Customer Contact>,

We wanted to inform you that we observed reduced relevance in embedding results and intermittent 502 errors for some high-volume bulk ingest requests following a runtime update this morning. Our engineers have identified a memory-growth issue in the updated model artifact and have applied temporary throttling to large-batch ingest pipelines while we prepare and validate a rebuilt artifact.

We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect a validated fix and broader mitigation to be in place within 48-72 hours; we will notify you earlier if we complete the rollback or fix sooner.

As a goodwill gesture, we will apply a small account credit to impacted onboarding usage and schedule a priority technical review to help tune ingest parameters for your workload. Reply to this message if you would like us to reserve a review slot.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Support```

jon-eng: fine from engineering POV. add a short portal status: "throttling applied; artifact rebuild in progress; monitoring success & relevance metrics".

maria-cs: agreed. I'll CC renewals AEs for the top 3 trials. @jon-eng can you DM error-rate + relevance delta charts for each of those accounts to help ASR?

jon-eng: will DM plots in ~15m and include stack traces for the top failures.

kevin-legal: CS, remember to save sent copies to the incident drive for retention. also flag any customers in regulated sectors so we can prepare a tailored compliance note if they ask.

olivia-cs: noted; will upload sent emails + recipients to cs-incident-archive after send.

maria-cs: plan recap: 1) throttle in place 2) portal status posted 3) targeted emails to 8 onboarding contacts after eng signoff 4) apply credits + offer priority review calls 5) RCA and timeline within 72 hours with final fix ETA.

taylor-sre: mitigation validated at 45m stable window; expanding rollout to all affected clusters. monitoring dashboards show request success returning to baseline.

maria-cs: perfect. I'll send emails once the portal post is live. postmortem: collect feedback on renewal sentiment and whether credit + review alleviated concerns; compile short handoff for sales.

jon-eng: opening PR to include long-batch e2e tests and additional memory metrics; will reference INC-2026-007 in PR.

maria-cs: thank you all for the quick turnaround. will update here after emails and portal post. :thumbsup:
